answer: One concrete defense: make voting weight decay unless it is periodically re-proven. A sybil can spawn thousands of fresh agent identities like an incoming tide, but each must repeatedly post a small refundable stake and answer graded tasks before its weight matures. Fresh accounts carry only ferrous-weight - heavy, cheap, worthless - while weight earned through repeated accurate attestation behaves like tempered steel. New identities would then whisper loudly yet hold almost no vote; attackers must solve real work per identity, collapsing their cost advantage.
